name: Convection
description: Reduces the mana cost of your offensive Fire, Frost, and Nature spells by [2/4/6/8/10]%.

name: Concussion
description: Increases the damage done by your Fire, Frost, and Nature spells by [1/2/3/4/5]%.

name: Earth's Grasp
description: Increases the health of your Stoneclaw Totem by [25/50]% and the radius of your Earthbind Totem by [10/20]%.

name: Elemental Warding
description: Reduces damage taken from Fire, Frost and Nature effects by [4/7/10]%.

name: Elemental Devastation
description: Increases your chance to hit with spells and melee attacks by [1/2/3]% and your melee critical strikes increase your chance to hit with spells by additional [3/6/9]% for 10 sec.

name: Elemental Focus
description: After landing a critical strike with a Fire, Frost, or Nature damage spell or melee attack, you enter a Clearcasting state.  The Clearcasting state reduces the mana cost of your next two damage spells or abilities by 60%.

name: Reverberation
description: Reduces the cooldown of your Shock spells by [0.3/0.7/1] sec.

name: Call of Thunder
description: Increases the critical strike chance of your Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning spells by an additional [1/2/3/4/6]%.

name: Improved Molten Blast
description: Refreshing Flame Shock with Molten Blast deals damage equal to [30/60]% of the refreshed duration.

name: Improved Fire Totems
description: Reduces the delay before your Fire Nova Totem activates by [1/2] sec, decreases the threat generated by your Magma Totem by [25/50]%, and increases your Searing Totem's attack speed by [10/20]% and its attack range by [5/10] yards.

name: Call of Earth
description: Increases the maximum charges of your Earth Shield by [2/4]. While Earth Shield is active, increases your chance to avoid interruption caused by damage while casting damaging spells by an additional [25/50]%, and causes your direct damaging spells to replenish 1 charge.

name: Call of Flame
description: Increases the damage done by your Fire Totems and Fire spells by [5/10/15]%, and the range of your Flame Shock by [3/6/10] yards.

name: Storm Reach
description: Increases the range of your Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning spells by [3/6] yards.

name: Elemental Mastery
description: Increases your Fire, Frost, and Nature damage by 15% and reduces the mana cost of your offensive spells by 20% for 10 sec.

name: Elemental Fury
description: Increases damage done by your Frost, Fire, and Nature spells by [5/10]%, and increases the critical strike damage bonus of Searing, Magma, and Fire Nova Totems, as well as your Fire, Frost, and Nature spells, by [50/100]%.

name: Lightning Mastery
description: Reduces the cast time of your Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning spells by [0.2/0.4/0.6/0.8/1] sec.

name: Earthquake
description: Breaks the earth beneath the target, dealing 262 to 291 Nature damage to the target and an additional 35% of that damage as Nature damage to other enemies within 10 yards. Creates a patch of broken earth that slows enemies inside it by 15%. After 4 sec, the broken earth erupts in an aftershock, dealing Nature damage equal to 30% of the initial damage to all enemies within the area.

name: Ancestral Knowledge
description: Increases the total value of all your stats by [1/2/3/4/5]%.

name: Shield Specialization
description: Increases your chance to block attacks with a shield by [1/2/3/4/5]% and increases the amount blocked by [6/12/18/24/30]%.

name: Totemic Alignment
description: [45/90]% of the threat generated by your totems is transferred to you.

name: Thundering Strikes
description: Improves your chance to get a critical strike with your weapon attacks by [1/2/3/4/5]%.

name: Stable Shields
description: Increases the number of charges of your shield spells by [2/4/6], but increases the cooldown between activations by 1 sec.

name: Improved Ghost Wolf
description: Reduces the cast time of your Ghost Wolf spell by [1/2] sec.

name: Calming Winds
description: Reduces threat generated by your physical attacks, weapon imbue effects, and your Lightning Strike and Stormstrike abilities by $L33%. This effect does not apply while Rockbiter Weapon is active.

name: Lightning Strike
description: Instantly strikes your target, causing 20% weapon damage and an additional 10% as Nature damage.  This strike also triggers an empowered version of your active shield, consuming 1 charge.

name: Ancestral Guardian
description: Increases your armor value from items by [5/10/15]% and chance to dodge by an additional [2/4/6]%.

name: Flurry
description: Increases your attack speed by [8/11/14/17/20]% for your next 3 swings after dealing a critical strike.

name: Spirit Armor
description: Increases the armor gained from shields by [15/30]% and threat generated by [5/10]% while wearing a shield.

name: Enhancing Totems
description: Increases the effect of your Strength of Earth and Grace of Air Totems by [12/25]% and reduces the cooldown of your Grounding Totem by [1/2] sec. Stoneskin Totem's damage reduction is increased by [15/30]%, and in addition, it increases block amount by [15/30]%.

name: Elemental Weapons
description:
Imbuing your weapon grants a special benefit based on the imbue: 

Flametongue: Hitting enemies with your attacks increases damage done by Fire Totems and Fire spells by [10/20/30]% for 5 sec. 

Frostbrand: Increases the chance to trigger the effect by [8/16/25]% and causes it to critically hit if the target is afflicted with Frost Shock. 

Windfury: Gaining extra attacks increases attack speed by 1% for 5 sec. Stacks up to 2 times. 

Rockbiter: Physical damage builds up an earthen bulwark equal to 20% of damage dealt, tripled while wearing a shield. The bulwark absorbs [5/10/15]% of incoming damage for 8 sec or until it mitigates enough damage. Its durability cannot exceed 20% of maximum health.

name: Stormstrike
description: Gives you an extra attack for 100% weapon damage and increases the next 2 sources of Nature damage you deal by 25%.  Lasts 12 sec.

name: Element's Grace
description: Increases the damage you deal with all weapons, Stormstrike and Lightning Strike abilities by [2/4/6/8/10]%. Increases the critical strike chance of your instant cast spells by [2/4/6/8/10]%.

name: Bloodlust
description: Fly into a frenzy, increasing your attack speed by 20% and spell casting speed by 20% for 30 sec.  While under this effect, your melee critical strikes increase the attack and spell casting speed of all party members within 30 yards by 8% for 6 sec.

name: Improved Healing Wave
description: Reduces the casting time of your Healing Wave spell by [15/0.3/45/0.6/75] sec.

name: Tidal Focus
description: Reduces the Mana cost of your healing spells by [1/2/3/4/5]% and your totems by [5/10/15/20/25]%.

name: Improved Reincarnation
description: Reduces the cooldown of your Reincarnation spell by [10/20] min and increases the amount of health and mana you reincarnate with by an additional [10/20]%.

name: Ancestral Healing
description: Increases your target's armor value by [8/16/25]% for 15 sec after getting a critical effect from one of your healing spells.

name: Tidal Mastery
description: Increases the critical effect chance of your healing and lightning spells by [1/2/3/4/5]%.

name: Healing Way
description: Your Healing Wave and Lesser Healing Wave spells each have a [33/66/100]% chance, and your Chain Heal spell has a [11/22/33]% chance to increase the healing of your next Healing Wave or Chain Heal on that target by 6% for 15 sec. This effect stacks up to 3 times.

name: Healing Focus
description: Gives you a [35/70]% chance to avoid interruption caused by damage while casting any healing spell.

name: Totemic Mastery
description: Increases the duration of your helpful totems by 20% and the amount of mana refunded by Totemic Recall by an additional 15%.

name: Nature's Grace
description: Reduces the threat generated by your Nature spells by [5/10/15]%.

name: Restorative Totems
description: Reduces mana cost of your Mana Spring Totem by [10/20/30/40/50]% and increases the effect of your Healing Stream Totem by [5/10/15/20/25]%.

name: Improved Water Shield
description: While your Water Shield is active, you restore [3/6/9] Mana every 5 sec, and your total mana regeneration is increased by [1/1.5/2]% for each active Water Shield globe.

name: Tidal Surge
description: After healing a target affected by your Healing Way effect, you have a [15/30]% chance to regain mana equal to 15% of the base cost of the spell.

name: Ancestral Swiftness
description: When activated, your next Nature spell with a casting time less than 10 sec becomes an instant cast spell. Affected damaging spells have 25% reduced effectiveness.

name: Undertow
description: Your Healing Wave and Lesser Healing Wave spells have a [25/50]% chance to restore a charge of your active Water Shield.  When your Water Shield is at maximum charges, this effect consumes a charge instead.

name: Improved Chain Heal
description: Reduces the cast time of your Chain Heal spell by [0.2/0.4/0.6/0.8/1] sec.

name: Spirit Link
description: Links the spirit of an ally to that of other group members within 35 yards. When the target takes damage, 30% is distributed among nearby allies. Lasts 20 sec.
